title: Breast Lump Evaluation: Triple Assessment Principles
subject: Surgery
preview: Triple assessment of a breast lump integrates clinical examination, appropriate imaging and tissue diagnosis when indicated.
quickRevision: Triple assessment of a breast lump integrates clinical examination, appropriate imaging and tissue diagnosis when indicated.
A suspicious palpable lump may need biopsy even when one imaging test is reassuring.
Assessment includes skin, nipple changes, nodes and family or personal risk history.

sections.title: Clinical syndrome and red flags
points: Triple assessment of a breast lump integrates clinical examination, appropriate imaging and tissue diagnosis when indicated.
Imaging is chosen by patient age, presentation and local guidelines rather than one universal modality.

sections.title: Differentiate and manage
points: A suspicious palpable lump may need biopsy even when one imaging test is reassuring.
Assessment includes skin, nipple changes, nodes and family or personal risk history.

sections.title: Exam trap — avoid this mistake
points: Do not label a persistent suspicious lump benign solely from a normal single test.

quiz.question: What are the components of breast lump triple assessment?
options: Clinical exam, imaging and tissue sampling when indicated
